subject: USAGE clause
notes: kb/Work PB495 landed the ONE derivation of an elementary item's EFFECTIVE usage -- its own USAGE clause, else the nearest enclosing group's (13.18.60.4 GR1) -- feeding the group-header shed, the leaf's representation and EVERY 13.18.60.3 screen through the SAME code the written-clause path runs (PictureAnalyzer.ScreenUsageAgainstPicture, extracted for the purpose). The invariant is stated and locked as an EQUIVALENCE rather than as cases: `01 G USAGE u. 05 A <pic>.` and `01 G. 05 A <pic> USAGE u.` are the same item, so they must produce the same verdict, the same diagnostic code and the same width, for EVERY member of the Usage enum. UsageInheritanceDriftTests enumerates the enum and asserts exactly that (24 members x 6 pictures x 2 arms). MEASURED on the pre-fix tree 39479e19: 108 of those 138 cells DIFFERED between the two arms; after the fix, 0 differ. THE RULE'S TWO SENTENCES NOW BOTH HOLD. (a) "it applies only to each elementary item in the group": a PICTURE-less leaf under a group-level BINARY-CHAR/-SHORT/-LONG/-DOUBLE, COMP-1/COMP-2, FLOAT-SHORT/-LONG/-EXTENDED, FLOAT-BINARY-32/-64 or INDEX now IS an item of that usage and takes its width (1/2/4/8, 4/8, 4/8/8, 4/8, 8) instead of the ZERO-LENGTH cell it was; a PICTURE-BEARING leaf under one of those usages draws the same 13.16.3 SR8 diagnostic, with the same code, that the written-clause spelling draws, instead of silently keeping its usage-display width. (b) "and not to the group itself": the group header sheds the profile entry bind synthesized for it -- for EVERY picture-less usage now, derived from DataItem.PicIsUsageSynthesized rather than from a hand-list of four shapes, so a group-level FLOAT-SHORT no longer emits the GROUP as a scalar C# float (a raw Roslyn CS1061 on every member reference, and the worst-harm arm of the finding). The MOVE-into-an-inherited-picture-less-leaf compiler crash (NullReferenceException in MoveEmitter.ConvertSource) goes with it, as does an NRE in ProgramEmitter.EmitCallMethod for the same shape used as a PROCEDURE DIVISION USING formal (the linkage formal's carrier-residency verdict was taken from the transient synthesized profile, before this pass sheds it; it is now the structural test). Also landed here: kb/Work PB520's roster -- 13.16.3 SR8's prohibition was five separate hand-written `if (entryUsage is ...)` arms in BindEntry with no INDEX arm, so `05 A PIC 9(4) USAGE INDEX.` silently DISCARDED the picture; it is now one screen over the one set.
